ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关联的新型计时方式这些状况可能因全球变暖而发生变化．我们正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座钟它反映了几条主要阿拉斯加河流的总流量这些河流对当地和全球的环境变化都很敏感．我们已经编程让它在水流保持当前速率时与原子钟同步．如果将来河流平均流速加快钟会比标准时间走得快．如果河流变慢你会看到相反的效果．

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即使这种计时方法的具体细节是新颖的早期农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来．例如在前古典希腊时期人们通过向前或向后调整日期来"修正"官方历法以反映季节的变化．与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要．同样河流时间和其他我们正在开发的计时系统可能会促进环保意识．

ex.s: Atomic time will get ahead of river time if the rivers run slower．

ex.s: What can we infer about Moran’s opinion on jazz?
ex.t: 要建造一个可工作的太阳能蒸馏器，用一根锋利的棍子或石头挖一个四英尺宽三英尺深的洞。

defs.def: to suggest indirectly that sth is true 间接地提出；暗示；意指

ex.s: For example, from the sentence “While the Moon can be reached within days, it would take months to reach Mars, travelling through dangerous solar radiation”, we can infer that the Moon is less exposed to dangerous radiation than Mars.
ex.t: 例如，从句子——虽然月球可以在几天内到达，但前往火星需要几个月，途中穿过危险的太阳辐射——中，我们可以推断月球比火星受到的太阳辐射少。

ex.s: Infer meaning ① ② ③ ④ UNIT 4 BODY LANGUAGE UNIT 4 BODY LANGUAGE Pronunciation Asking for and giving clarification What did you mean by …?
ex.t: 推断含义。第四单元 肢体语言。发音：请求和给出澄清。你说的是什么意思？

ex.s: However, if a student does not bother to brush her hair and her eyes are red from weeping, then I can infer that there are deeper issues at work.
ex.t: 然而，如果一个学生懒得梳头、眼睛因哭泣而发红，那么我可以推断有更深层次的问题。

ex.s: To infer means to guess something based on the evidence.
ex.t: 推断意味着基于证据来猜测某事。

ex.s: Infer character traits and emotions 20 May 1916 We have been struggling for days, but things on Elephant Island are going from bad to worse.
ex.t: 推断人物特征和情感：1916年5月20日。我们已经挣扎了好几天，但象岛上的情况越来越糟。

defs.def: having a lot of influence on sb/sth 有很大影响的；有支配力的

ex.s: The world has always had influential people, for instance, but only now do we have “Influencer”.
ex.t: 同样，企业界当然也经历过相当程度的颠覆，但只是在过去几十年里，"颠覆者"（Disruptor）才成为我们谈论大企业时的一个知名概念。

ex.s: For well over a hundred years the most influential English dictionary was Samuel Johnson's Dictionary of the English Language published in 1755.
ex.t: 在长达一百多年的时间里，最有影响力的英语词典是塞缪尔·约翰逊1755年出版的《英语词典》。

ex.s: The tests show that the social environment is extremely influential when we’re making decisions.
ex.t: 测试表明，当我们做决定时，社会环境的影响极大。

ex.s: He is one of the most influential thinkers of all time.
ex.t: 他是有史以来最有影响力的思想家之一。

ex.s: It's a form of sport and entertainment which was influential in China for more than 2,000 years.
ex.t: 这是一种运动与娱乐相结合的形式，在中国影响了两千多年。

ex.s: As his longest play, it is considered among the most powerful and influential works of world literature.
ex.t: 作为他最长的戏剧，它被认为是世界文学中最有力、最有影响力的作品之一。

ex.s: His informal but sophisticated style of writing, in both Chinese and English, made him one of the most influential writers of his generation.
ex.t: 他非正式而又成熟的写作风格，无论是中文还是英文，使他成为他那一代最有影响力的作家之一。

ex.s: Edgar Snow was an American journalist who wrote influential books and articles about China in the 1930s.
ex.t: 埃德加·斯诺是一位美国记者，他在二十世纪三十年代写了关于中国的有影响力的书籍和文章。

defs.def: the first letter of a person's first name （名字的）首字母

ex.s: Created by Salk Fellow Talmo Pereira, SLEAP was initially designed to track animal movement in the lab.
ex.t: SLEAP由萨尔克研究员塔尔莫·佩雷拉创建，最初设计用于在实验室中追踪动物运动。

ex.s: During your initial reading of material, do you ever go back and reread sentences or paragraphs?
ex.t: 在你初次阅读材料时，你是否会回过头来重读某些句子或段落？

ex.s: “They come to us thinking vegetables are awful, dirt is awful, insects are awful.” Though some are initially scared of the insects and turned off by the dirt, most are eager to try something new.
ex.t: “他们来找我们时，认为蔬菜很讨厌，泥土很讨厌，昆虫很讨厌。”虽然有些人一开始害怕昆虫、厌恶泥土，但大多数人都渴望尝试新事物。

ex.s: Initially the sugar tax was expected to make £520m a year for the Treasury.
ex.t: 然而，前六个月的数据显示收入将不到这个数字的一半。

ex.s: It would affect his/her initial plans．
ex.t: 这会影响他/她的最初计划．

ex.s: What was the author’s initial purpose of collecting newspaper articles?
ex.t: 作者最初收集报纸文章的目的是什么？

ex.s: Google initially used the data collected from users to target advertising better.
ex.t: 谷歌最初利用收集到的用户数据更好地定向投放广告。

ex.s: His initial journey to India opened up the sea route from Western Europe to the east by way of the Cape of Good Hope.
ex.t: 他最初到达印度的航行开辟了从西欧通过好望角通往东方的海上航线。

ex.s: "The biggest challenge at the initial phase was to persuade people to work for me, which was totally outside my experience.
ex.t: 最初阶段最大的挑战是说服人们为我工作，这完全超出了我的经验。

ex.s: You may not believe it, but that was happened at the initial stage of our group’s research on developing a vaccine for malaria.
ex.t: 你可能不相信，但那发生在我们小组研究开发疟疾疫苗的初始阶段。

ex.s: His father was his teacher initially and he was shocked by the ability of his young son.
ex.t: 他父亲最初是他的老师，他被他年幼儿子的能力震惊了。

ex.s: When they initially did this, Helen thought it was a game.
ex.t: 当他们最初这样做时，海伦以为这是一个游戏。

defs.def: the first letters of all of a person's names （全名的）首字母
a new plan for dealing with a particular problem or for achieving a particular purpose 倡议；新方案

ex.s: In line with longstanding initiatives to expand its green spaces, New York City is planting tens of thousands of trees each year.
ex.t: 为配合长期以来扩大绿色空间的举措，纽约市每年种植数万棵树木。

ex.s: A four-year tea promotion —Tea Road Cooperative Plan—was also issued in accordance with the initiative.
ex.t: 我们都知道骑自行车是一项很好的运动。

defs.def: the ability to decide and act on your own without waiting for sb to tell you what to do 主动性；积极性；自发性

ex.s: This century is bringing the Silk Road to life once more through the Belt and Road Initiative.
ex.t: 这个世纪正通过一带一路倡议再次将丝绸之路带入生活。

ex.s: Background information • The Belt and Road Initiative comprises the Silk Road Economic Belt and the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road, and is designed to connect Asia with the rest of the world.
ex.t: 背景信息：一带一路倡议包括丝绸之路经济带和21世纪海上丝绸之路，旨在将亚洲与世界其他地区连接起来。

ex.s: China’s global outlook, with projects such as the Belt and Road Initiative, has helped us make connections across the world.
ex.t: 中国的全球视野，包括一带一路倡议等项目，帮助我们在世界各地建立联系。

ex.s: A comprehensive initiative was started, with a number of measures that addressed the issues.
ex.t: 一项全面的倡议被启动，包含了应对问题的一系列措施。

defs.def: the power or opportunity to act and gain an advantage before other people do 掌握有利条件的能力（或机会）；主动权
(in some states of the US) a process by which ordinary people can suggest a new law by signing a petition （美国某些州的）公民立法提案程序

ex.s: What’s more, the Belt and Road Initiative will mean a new dawn for trade and investment between countries, leading into a new era of prosperity.
ex.t: 更重要的是，一带一路倡议将意味着国家间贸易和投资的新曙光，引领一个繁荣的新时代。

defs.def: harm done to a person's or an animal's body, for example in an accident （对躯体的）伤害，损伤

ex.s: Once there, Lenoue was ____29____ and later taken to a hospital, where she learned that she had serious injuries in one of her knees.
ex.t: 到达那里后，勒努接受了____29____，随后被送往医院，在那里她得知自己的一个膝盖受了重伤。

ex.s: Race walking shares many fitness benefits with running, research shows, while most likely contributing to fewer injuries.
ex.t: 不过，它也有自己的问题。

ex.s: As a result, she says, some of the injuries associated with running, such as runner’s knee, are uncommon among race walkers.
ex.t: 但这项运动的奇特形式确实会给脚踝和髋部带来相当大的压力，所以有过此类伤病史的人在选择这项运动时应谨慎。

ex.s: But the sport’s strange form does place considerable stress on the ankles and hips, so people with a history of such injuries might want to be cautious in adopting the sport.
ex.t: 事实上，任何想尝试竞走的人最好先请教教练或有经验的竞走者学习正确的技巧，她说。

ex.s: It’s less likely to cause knee injuries.
ex.t: 30 对于想尝试竞走的人，Norberg博士有什么建议？

ex.s: Would you BET on the future of this man？ He is 53 years old． Most of his adult life has been a losing struggle against debt and misfortune． A war injury has made his left hand stop functioning， and he has often been in prison． Driven by heaven﹣knows﹣what motives， he determines to write a book．
ex.t: （5）预警系统如何帮助我们维持生态平衡？

ex.s: They are required    63    (process) the food that we eat, to recover from injury and for several other bodily functions.
ex.t: 它们是____（处理）我们所吃的食物、从伤病中恢复以及其他多种身体功能所必需的。

defs.def: damage to a person's feelings （对感情的）伤害，挫伤

ex.s: You once missed a national dragon boat race because of injuries.
ex.t: 你曾因伤病错过了一场全国龙舟比赛。

ex.s: Although it's the doctors and nurses who will treat her injury，it's my job to make her feel better.
ex.t: 虽然是医生和护士治疗她的伤势，但我的工作让她感觉更好。

ex.s: In this zero gravity world, there is no up or down, and while sleeping on the ceiling might sound like fun, astronauts need to be strapped to sleeping compartments to protect themselves from injury.
ex.t: 在这个零重力世界里，没有上下之分，虽然在天花板上睡觉听起来可能很有趣，但宇航员需要被绑在睡眠舱上以保护自己免受伤害。

ex.s: Rescue workers are trained to find people, treat injuries, and hand out food, water, and other supplies.
ex.t: 救援人员经过培训，能够找到幸存者、处理伤情并分发食物、水和其他物资。

ex.s: Speaking of medicine, through new technology, people who have brain or spinal injuries will be able to find new hope.
ex.t: 说到医学，通过新技术，有脑部或脊髓损伤的人将能找到新的希望。

defs.def: inside; towards or close to the centre of a place 里面的；向内的；内部的；接近中心的

ex.s: She regains her inner peace.
ex.t: 她重获内心的平静。

ex.s: His presentation not only awed and inspired me, but also helped emerge an inner desire to make a difference in the world.
ex.t: 他的演讲不仅让我惊叹和受到启发，还激发了我内心想要在这个世界做出改变的愿望。

defs.def: private and secret; not expressed or shown to other people 感情等

ex.s: Join us on 4 ________ and let our experienced director help you find your inner star.
ex.t: 在……加入我们，让我们经验丰富的导演帮你发现你内心的明星。

ex.s: Its artist, Han Gan, is known for his skill in capturing not only the physical features of the animal, but also its inner spirit and strength.
ex.t: 它的创作者韩幹以不仅能捕捉到动物的外在特征、还能捕捉其内在精神和力量而闻名。

ex.s: Dr Hart says: It’s true that inner beauty is very important, but external beauty shouldn’t be completely overlooked.
ex.t: 哈特博士说：内在美确实非常重要，但外在美也不应被完全忽视。

ex.s: His portrait ages and reveals his inner ugliness.
ex.t: 他的画像随着岁月流逝，揭示了他内心的丑陋。

ex.s: Despite her plain appearance and lack of fashion sense, she lands a job at a reputable fashion magazine and sets out on a journey to explore her inner beauty.
ex.t: 尽管她外表平凡、缺乏时尚感，但她在一家著名的时尚杂志找到了一份工作，并开始了一段探索自己内在美的旅程。

defs.def: not guilty of a crime, etc; not having done sth wrong 无辜的；清白的；无罪的

ex.s: her innocent childhood in the country
ex.t: 她在其他项目中的经验

ex.s: Soon afterwards, Dorian is surprised to find his wish has come true, after he meets Sybil, an innocent actress who falls in love with him.
ex.t: 不久之后，多里安惊讶地发现，在他遇到了西比尔——一位爱上他的纯真女演员之后，他的愿望成真了。

ex.s: Although it was completely innocent, Claire felt guilty.
ex.t: 虽然这件事完全是无辜的，但克莱尔感到内疚。

ex.s: Its big eyes seem (be) those of an innocent child.
ex.t: 它的大眼睛看起来像一个纯真孩子的眼睛。

ex.s: They put me in prison, but, in the end, I was proved innocent.
ex.t: 他们把我关进监狱，但最后，我被证明是无辜的。

ex.s: I felt it was my duty to help innocent people who are caught in the middle of these conflicts, so I signed up with the United Nations.
ex.t: 我觉得帮助那些陷入这些冲突中的无辜的人是我的责任，所以我报名参加了联合国。

defs.def: suffering harm or being killed because of a crime, war, etc. although not directly involved in it 无辜受害的；成为牺牲品的
having little experience of the world, especially of sexual matters, or of evil or unpleasant things 天真无邪的；纯真的
not intended to cause harm or upset sb 无恶意的；无冒犯之意的
the introduction of new things, ideas or ways of doing sth （新事物、思想或方法的）创造；创新；改革

ex.s: Innovation should move forward the wheel of tradition.
ex.t: 改革应汲取过往智慧的源泉。

ex.s: Their app quickly grew popular in town and even won a local youth innovation award.
ex.t: 他才25岁，状态依然很好。

ex.s: An innovation is a resolution.
ex.t: 创新是一种解决方案。

ex.s: 31.Technological innovations, ____ good marketing, will promote the sales of these products.
ex.t: 31.技术创新，加上良好的营销，将促进这些产品的销售。

ex.s: Who can provide Lancom with a huge potential for innovation in learning? （    ）
ex.t: 灵活的系统。

ex.s: 62.What does the technological innovation in Paragraph 3 indicate?
ex.t: 62.第3段中的技术创新表明了什么？

defs.def: a new idea, way of doing sth, etc. that has been introduced or discovered 新思想；新方法

ex.s: Such innovation will, without doubt, 3______________ of technological discovery What’s more, it seems that Tech-Hub 4 on local schools, with more students than ever applying to study Computer Science at university.
ex.t: 这种创新毫无疑问地将推动技术发现。而且，看起来科技中心对当地学校产生了影响，比以往任何时候都更多的学生申请在大学学习计算机科学。

ex.s: In addition to new stage designs and singing styles, his innovations in make-up and costume design allowed for more vivid depictions of female characters.
ex.t: 除了新的舞台设计和演唱风格，他在化妆和服装设计方面的创新使得女性角色的描绘更加生动。

ex.s: Their expertise in science, perseverance, integrity and innovation have inspired generations of scientific researchers to work towards a more powerful and prosperous China.
ex.t: 他们在科学上的专长、毅力、正直和创新激励了一代又一代的科学研究人员为建设一个更强大、更繁荣的中国而努力。

ex.s: Perseverance Integrity Innovation Expertise Now comment on each other’s performances in using the words and expressions in this section.
ex.t: 毅力、正直、创新、专长。现在用本节中的词和表达评论彼此的表演。

ex.s: This new generation of artisans will not only help preserve traditional skills; the innovation they bring to the craft will also ensure that the art of clock repairing stands the test of time.
ex.t: 这新一代工匠不仅将帮助保存传统技艺；他们为手工艺带来的创新也将确保钟表修复艺术经得起时间的考验。

defs.def: time, knowledge, ideas, etc. that you put into work, a project, etc. in order to make it succeed; the act of putting sth in 投入资源（指时间、知识、思想等）；投入；输入

ex.s: With human inputs dramatically reduced, the garden’s ecology can develop well.
ex.t: 在人类中，高度发达的大脑增强了自律能力，正如它增强了在社交和物理世界中的解决问题能力一样。

ex.s: However, hedgehogs remain open to others’ reactions and inputs.
ex.t: 然而，刺猬仍然对其他人的反应和意见持开放态度。

ex.s: He had an inquiring mind.
ex.t: 他有求知若渴的头脑。

defs.def: the act of putting information into a computer; the information that you put in 输入；输入的信息

ex.s: A few, like Zhang Yue, find themselves lucky enough to get investment and the all-important input and support from more experienced business people.
ex.t: 像张月这样的一些人很幸运地获得了投资，以及来自更有经验的商业人士的重要投入和支持。

ex.s: Humans are capable of making decisions by themselves without input from others, and they can learn from experience.
ex.t: 人类能够在不依赖他人输入的情况下做出决定，并且他们可以从经验中学习。

ex.s: So I was unhappy about her leaving without even asking for my input.
ex.t: 所以她连问都不问我一声就走了，我很不高兴。

ex.s: REFLECTING contract disability tune input share mechanic stability criterion consultation Many of us have worked as volunteers before.
ex.t: 反思：合同、残疾、调整、投入、分享、机械、稳定、标准、咨询。我们许多人以前都做过志愿者。

ex.s: One of the essential aims of AI is to develop computer intelligence capable of learning from experience, adjusting to new inputs and performing tasks like humans.
ex.t: AI的基本目标之一是开发能够从经验中学习、适应新输入并像人类一样执行任务的计算机智能。

defs.def: a place or means for electricity, data, etc. to enter a machine or system （电、数据等的）输入端
inquire ★★

ex.s: Whatever it is, I know I need to inquire and assess what is going on.
ex.t: 不管是什么，我知道我需要询问和评估正在发生的事情。

ex.s: Instead, you should inquire further to assess the truth of what you are being told.
ex.t: 相反，你应该进一步询问来评估你被告知的事情的真实性。

defs.def: the ability to see and understand the truth about people or situations 洞察力；领悟

ex.s: This mountain walk provides an insight into the skills required for hillwalking to ensure you get the most from future walking trips.
ex.t: 这次山地徒步让你了解山地徒步所需的技能，确保你在今后的徒步旅行中收获最大。

ex.s: Mr Bissell skillfully organizes historical insights and cultural references, making his tale a well-rounded picture of Uzbekistan, seen from Western eyes.
ex.t: 比塞尔先生巧妙地将历史洞察和文化参考编织在一起使他的故事成为从西方人眼中看到的乌兹别克斯坦的完整画面。

ex.s: History has the potential to break down those boundaries by offering us insight into entire worlds that would otherwise be foreign to us.
ex.t: 历史有潜力打破这些界限，让我们深入了解那些对我们来说原本陌生的世界。

ex.s: The work has also brought insights for museums, Smith says.
ex.t: 更重要的是，复原可能是了解珍宝在被时间磨损之前样貌的唯一途径。

ex.s: If we can rediscover the values of hands-on experience and craftwork, Smith says, we can marry the best of our modern insights with the handiness of our ancestors.
ex.t: 对专业术语感到困惑。

ex.s: This insight grew from the determined attitude of a six-year-old boy who had the courage and perseverance to make his dream a reality.
ex.t: 这种领悟源于一个六岁男孩的坚定态度，他有勇气和毅力把自己的梦想变成现实。

ex.s: I admire Snow’s special insight and bravery, risking his life during the war to get to the heart of the story and correct prejudice.
ex.t: 我钦佩斯诺的非凡洞察力和勇气，他在战争中冒着生命危险去了解故事的核心，并纠正偏见。

ex.s: It has in fact become one of the most famous American poems of all time, not only because of its natural style, but also because of its thoughtful insights into human nature.
